status.verified.help: Confirmed by at least two independent sources, one primary or official.
status.disputed.help: Identity, location or membership is disputed; credible variants are shown.

map.label: Map of sacred sites. A list version is available in the Cards and Table views.

site.related: Related sites and other names for this place

site.noSources: No sources have been recorded yet.
